## Core Ventures & Projects
- **Dabbirha AI Automation Agency (وكالة دبّرها لأتمتة المنظومات):** Automating business workflows and enterprise operations using advanced autonomous AI agents and intelligent systems.
- **Sovereign Earth (الأرض السيادية):** An ambitious MMORPG game integrating complex socio-economic systems, system dynamics, and strategic worldbuilding.
- **Philosophical Compass (البوصلة الفلسفية):** An interactive cognitive assessment tool mapping intellectual frameworks (Rationalism, Empiricism, Stoicism, Existentialism, Pragmatism): https://yznbadarneh.com/quiz.html
- **Mental Solitude Station (محطة العزلة الذهنية):** An interactive mindfulness and cognitive reflection experience: https://yznbadarneh.com/solitude.html
